7wz5_A.label: Severe failure: long-range features missing
7wz5_A.note: The predicted map concentrates near the diagonal and misses the truth's prominent off-diagonal traces. Long-range contacts are 91% of the truth but only 28% of top-R predictions. Even the oracle ±2 one-to-one correction reaches only 15.9%.

8arl_A.label: Severe failure: wrong overall pattern
8arl_A.note: The truth has a striking diamond-like set of off-diagonal traces. The prediction instead forms a band of mostly local contacts. Only 56.5% of true contacts appear in any rollout, and missed contacts have a median of 1/100 votes. This is much larger than a residue-register error.

8bux_A.label: Severe failure: local contacts replace distant ones
8bux_A.note: The N-terminal off-diagonal arc and much of the C-terminal pattern are absent or displaced. Long-range contacts fall from 74% in truth to 27% in the prediction. Gray bands are unresolved residues, excluded from scoring rather than counted as negatives.

8dmu_A.label: Severe failure: broad long-range coverage loss
8dmu_A.note: The prediction puts dense local clusters near the diagonal while missing many distant bands, including contacts between the ends of the sequence. Long-range contacts fall from 73% of truth to 37% of predictions. A few regions agree, but the overall pattern is substantially wrong.

7xz3_A.label: Mixed result: accurate and inaccurate regions
7xz3_A.note: Several off-diagonal traces are recovered, while the C-terminal region loses much of its structured contact pattern. The first region also contains extra local contacts. 98.4% of true contacts appear somewhere among the rollouts; their presence alone does not place them in the top-R map.

7uk8_A.label: Mixed result: recognizable map, wrong detailed contacts
7uk8_A.note: Many broad contact features align with truth, yet fine-scale additions, omissions and shifts leave only 52.9% exact precision. One-to-one ±2 correction reaches 70.5%, so local detail explains part of this case but still leaves a large residual.

8b6a_A.label: Moderate result: local clutter and missing traces
8b6a_A.note: Several large features are in the right places, but the prediction overpopulates a local N-terminal cluster and underrepresents some longer-range traces. Although 95.4% of predictions are within ±2 of some true contact, one-to-one correction reaches only 73.3%: nearby contacts are not interchangeable.

7y8h_A.label: Positive control: most features recovered
7y8h_A.note: The major off-diagonal traces and small contact clusters line up closely. Exact precision is 84.3%; ±2 one-to-one correction adds only 3.6 points. This confirms that the same representation and scoring path can recover detailed maps for some proteins.
